text:
sam: deploybot just flagged OOMs in eu-west1 canary for redwood-quant-v2. proposing fastpatch: pin to v2.1.3-quant-fix + KV-cache cap. requesting expedited approvals from releases + ml-infra + oncall.
anya: confirmed on dashboard — 4/6 canary replicas OOMed on long-seq traffic spike.
lee: quick q: is the change limited to a small guard? any perf regressions expected?
oncall-anna: I'll watch live. need rollback criteria before ack. propose: rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > +250ms for 10m. also must be able to pin specific customers back to legacy quickly.
sam: agree. deploy command: ```bash
deploybot release start --service=ml-serving --image=redwood-quant:v2.1.3-quant-fix --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --auto-rollback=false --meta="expedite:kv-cap"
```
releasebot: @sam created release r-20260318-01. Draft note: "Hotfix: KV-cache key cap to prevent OOMs on quantized model; pins image v2.1.3-quant-fix."
deploybot: initiating canary 5% in eu-west1. tasks: [provision] [deploy] [smoke].
oncall-anna: 10m check at 5%: no 5xx spike, p95 +12ms, gpu mem stable. recommend ramp to 30%.
anya: +1 expedite. post status update to customers in impacted region.
lee: +1 but request manual pause at 30% for 20m monitoring.
deploybot: ramping to 30% (manual pause scheduled).
20m_check (oncall-anna): 30% hold complete, no regressions observed. proceeding to full rollout.
deploybot: rollout to 100% eu-west1 complete.
sam: post-rollout sanity: OOMs dropped to baseline, p95 within normal range. filing follow-up test/CI work.
oncall-anna: leaving elevated monitors for 24h. will open incident if any customer reports.
anya: status blurb ready: "Hotfix deployed: KV-cache cap applied to redwood-quant-v2 (v2.1.3-quant-fix) — mitigated EU OOMs; no user-visible regression."
sam: updated internal changelog and posted to #customer-status. closing release.
releasebot: release r-20260318-01 closed, changelog entry added.
